pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal regions with sharp, high-contrast pixel gradients at the edges. Geometry features acute angular protrusions extending into the interstitial pathways, particularly on the mid-neck section.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous negative-space pathways of light-colored pelage. Network consists of wide primary channels forming distinct three-way and four-way junction nodes. Continuity is high across the neck and shoulder with minimal occlusion.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged profile along the dorsal neck. Individual hair bundles create a consistent, repetitive sawtooth silhouette against the sky background.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A prominent structural discontinuity or dip in the mane line occurs at the base of the neck where it transitions to the shoulder ridge.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A distinct, vertically-oriented area of white de-pigmentation and textural thickening is visible on the posterior dorsal ridge and upper flank.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent, vertically-aligned lesion featuring localized hyper-keratosis and loss of pigment on the posterior dorsal ridge, characteristic of giraffe skin disease-type symptoms.
